verdicts.reason: A and B are pixel-identical. Both break the title: 'HOHOHO AGENCY' is split, and 'HOHOHO' now sits under the 'Office Secret Santa' tagline as small sans text, so the reading order is wrong. Both also have the same layout flaws: the light-blue ring and red zigzags are cut off with a hard vertical edge at mid-canvas, the festive shapes are shrunk into a cramped strip along the bottom edge, and there is a large dead white area on the right and middle, so the lively scattered composition of the original is lost.
